lines.say: Dray came in every two weeks for four years. Then seven weeks went by.
So you open a missing persons case, and check his Instagram. Fresh fade. Definitely not yours.
So you drive across Atlanta, in a rental you've covered in plants so he won't spot you.
You find him at Tony's, scrolling his phone. He looks up and goes, oh hey, I meant to book.
Sure he did. One text at week three, and he never leaves.
caps: Sure he did. One text at *week three*
